note: LBL NRA self-service campground (USFS) on the Tennessee side near Dover, on a point of Kentucky Lake beside the Boswell Landing boat ramp. Designated gravel pads among trees, picnic tables, grills, fire rings, trash pickup. Reached by FS roads 230/232/233, paved and gravel. --Claude
summary: Boswell Landing: LBL self-service page + alerts, rec.gov search, Dyrt reviews, OSM, Esri, 3DEP read. $10 per unit, year-round, self-service FCFS (no rec.gov or LBL reservation listing). Lakefront kept on terrain and imagery, but site numbers could not be tied to positions. Elevation 123 -> ~111.5.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept (borderline on the named-site rule): pads on the loop sit 110.5-111.7 m, 1-2.3 m above the 109.4 m summer pool, which runs ~7-14 m north of them (e.g. pad ground 111.74 m at 36.519566,-88.024426 vs pool line ~36.51966 at the same longitude, ~13 deg; east end 111.1 m at 36.519500,-88.024152 with the line ~10 m north) - passes the kayak test. Ground cover: open gaps in a partial shoreline treeline - sand opening at ~36.51967,-88.02470, open gravel to the water at the east end ~36.5195,-88.0240; elsewhere along the north shore a tree fringe. Site numbers are not published (camper review names sites 11 and 15 without positions), so the open-edge pads cannot be named; all sites are sold nightly (self-service). If the named-site requirement is strict, the fallback is lakeview.
